Name: Wearable Perfumes Mod
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
[b]Abrah’s Perfumes – Wearable Scents & NPC Reactions ✧[/b]

This mod adds a full perfume system to Stardew Valley, letting you wear scents that actually help increase your friendship with your favorite npcs ?
You can purchase a [b]Perfume Drawer from Robin's Shop, [/b]which acts as your main source for all perfumes. Once placed, you can interact with it to browse and obtain every scent. The drawer can be placed anywhere you want, inside or outside, so you can style your farm however you like ✨

When you apply a perfume, it is consumed and applied to your character.

[b]Once worn, a soft colored smoke will follow you around. The color matches the mood and notes of the perfume, creating a beautiful trailing effect as you move✨ The perfume effect only lasts half a game day and it will dissappear after that but if you want to apply another perfume while wearing one you can apply it and it will replace the one before it.
[/b]
[line]
[b]
NPC Reactions & Friendship ?[/b]
Every NPC has a favorite perfume. If you are wearing a scent they love, they will compliment you and your friendship will increase by [b]+20 points[/b]. This can happen once per day per NPC.

Each perfume is liked by at least two NPCs, so there are multiple ways to discover preferences.

If you gift an NPC their favorite perfume, they will love it and your friendship will increase by [b]+80 points[/b]. If it is their birthday, this bonus becomes even higher ?

If you give a perfume an NPC does not like, they will not react positively.

Part of the fun is discovering preferences naturally. Walk around town wearing different perfumes and see who reacts to you.
[b]A read me file is included with all NPC preferences listed, but it is recommended not to check it right away so you can discover everything on your own [/b]?
